qe: What was the total population of Bihar as per Census 2011, and where did it rank among Indian states?
qh: जनगणना 2011 के अनुसार बिहार की कुल जनसंख्या कितनी थी तथा भारतीय राज्यों में इसका स्थान क्या था?
oe: About 10.41 crore; third most populous state
About 19.98 crore; first most populous state
About 6.86 crore; seventh most populous state
About 11.24 crore; second most populous state
oh: लगभग 10.41 करोड़; तीसरा सर्वाधिक जनसंख्या वाला राज्य
लगभग 19.98 करोड़; पहला सर्वाधिक जनसंख्या वाला राज्य
लगभग 6.86 करोड़; सातवाँ सर्वाधिक जनसंख्या वाला राज्य
लगभग 11.24 करोड़; दूसरा सर्वाधिक जनसंख्या वाला राज्य
e: Census 2011 me Bihar ki kul jansankhya 10,40,99,452 tha, yaani lagbhag 10.41 crore - isme lagbhag 5.43 crore purush tatha 4.98 crore mahilayein thi. Jansankhya ke aadhaar par Bihar bharat ka teesra sabse bada rajya tha (Uttar Pradesh tatha Maharashtra ke baad) tatha desh ki kul jansankhya ka lagbhag 8.6 pratishat hissa Bihar me tha. Population ka bada hissa gaon me rehta hai, kyunki urbanisation sirf lagbhag 11.29 pratishat thi; district me Patna sabse adhik tatha Sheikhpura sabse kam jansankhya wala jila tha. 19.98 crore Uttar Pradesh ke aas-paas ka figure hai, 6.86 crore Tamil Nadu jaisa tatha 11.24 crore Maharashtra ke aas-paas ka aakda hai, isliye woh Bihar ke liye sahi nahi hain. Isi liye Bihar ke jansankhya-tathya ko yaad rakhna har state-level pariksha ke liye zaroori hai. Exam point: Census 2011 me Bihar ki jansankhya = 10,40,99,452 (10.41 crore), desh me teesra sthan; sabse adhik jansankhya wala jila Patna, sabse kam Sheikhpura.

qe: Which districts of Bihar had the highest and the lowest population density as per Census 2011?
qh: जनगणना 2011 के अनुसार बिहार के किन जिलों में जनसंख्या घनत्व सर्वाधिक तथा न्यूनतम था?
e: Janasankhya ghanatv (population density) ka matlab hai ek square kilometre me kitne log rehte hain. Census 2011 me Bihar ki ausat ghanatv 1,102 vyakti prati square kilometre thi, jo bharat ki ausat 382 se lagbhag teen guna zyada hai - yani Bihar desh ke sabse ghane rajyon me aata hai. Rajya me sabse zyada ghanatv Sheohar jile ki thi (lagbhag 1,882 vyakti prati square kilometre), kyunki Sheohar ka kshetrafal chhota hai par abadi gani hui hai. Sabse kam ghanatv Kaimur jile ki thi (lagbhag 488 vyakti prati square kilometre), kyunki wahan pahadi, pathri tatha van-kshetra adhik hai, jahan log kam baste hain. Darbhanga, Patna tatha Munger bhi ghanatv me aage hain, par sabse adhik Sheohar hi hai; Banka, Jamui tatha Rohtas ki ghanatv Kaimur se thodi zyada rehti hai, isliye woh sahi jodi nahi. Exam point: Bihar ki 2011 ghanatv = 1,102 vyakti prati square kilometre; sabse adhik Sheohar, sabse kam Kaimur; bharat ki ausat se lagbhag teen guna.

qe: As per Census 2011, which district of Bihar had the highest sex ratio and which had the lowest?
qh: जनगणना 2011 के अनुसार बिहार के किस जिले में लिंगानुपात सर्वाधिक तथा किसमें न्यूनतम था?
e: Linganupat (sex ratio) batata hai ki har 1,000 purushon par kitni mahilayein hain. Census 2011 me Bihar ka ausat linganupat 918 tha, jo bharat ke 943 se 25 ank kam tha - yani Bihar me purushon ki sankhya mahilaon se kaafi zyada hai. Rajya me sabse achha linganupat Gopalganj jile ka tha (1,021 mahilayein prati 1,000 purush), jabki sabse kam Munger jile ka (876) tha. Iska ek karan yah hai ki shehri tatha pravasi-pravaah wale ilaake me purushon ka anupat badh jaata hai, kyunki mard kaam ke liye bahar jaate hain tatha gine jaate hain apne gaon me. Bihar ki sarkar ne linganupat sudharne ke liye 'Beti Bachao Beti Padhao' tatha aisi yojnayein chalaayi hain, jisse ladkiyon ki padhai, poshan tatha suraksha badhe. Patna, Kishanganj tatha Muzaffarpur ke diye gaye aankde sahi nahi hain, isliye sahi jodi 'Gopalganj-Munger' hai. Exam point: Bihar ka 2011 linganupat = 918; sabse adhik Gopalganj (1,021), sabse kam Munger (876); bharat ka linganupat 943 tha.

qe: In Census 2011, what was Bihar's overall literacy rate, and which district had the highest literacy?
qh: जनगणना 2011 के अनुसार बिहार की कुल साक्षरता दर क्या थी तथा किस जिले में सर्वाधिक साक्षरता थी?
e: Census 2011 ke antim aankdon me Bihar ki kul saaksharta dar 61.80 pratishat thi - isme purushon ki saaksharta 71.20 pratishat tatha mahilaon ki 51.50 pratishat thi, yaani lingaantar (gender gap) lagbhag 19.70 pratishat ank ka tha. Bihar ki saaksharta 2001 ke 47.53 pratishat se badh kar 2011 me 61.80 pratishat hui, phir bhi yah bharat ki 74.04 pratishat se kam rahi. Rajya me sabse zyada saaksharta Rohtas jile ki thi (lagbhag 75.59 pratishat) tatha sabse kam Purnia jile ki (lagbhag 52.49 pratishat). Saaksharta badhane ke liye Bihar me Mukhyamantri Balak-Balika Cycle Yojana, Kanya Utthan Yojana, school infrastructure tatha mid-day meal jaise kary chalaye gaye, jisse ladkiyon ki school tak pahunch badhi. Isliye prashn ka sahi jawab '61.80 pratishat, Rohtas' hai tatha 74.04 pratishat bharat ki saaksharta dar hai, Bihar ki nahi. Exam point: Bihar ki 2011 saaksharta = 61.80% (purush 71.20%, mahila 51.50%); sarvadhik saaksharita wala jila Rohtas (75.59%), sarvanimn Purnia (52.49%); bharat ki saaksharta 74.04%.

qe: What was the decadal population growth rate of Bihar between 2001 and 2011, and which district recorded the highest growth?
qh: 2001 से 2011 के बीच बिहार की दशकीय जनसंख्या वृद्धि दर कितनी थी तथा किस जिले में सर्वाधिक वृद्धि दर्ज हुई?
e: 2001 se 2011 ke beech Bihar ki dasahkiya (10 saal ki) jansankhya vriddhi lagbhag 25.42 pratishat thi, jabki bharat ki vriddhi 17.64 pratishat thi; iska arth Bihar me abadi bharat ki ausat se tez raftaar se badhi. Rajya me sabse zyada vriddhi Madhepura jile me dekhi gayi (lagbhag 31.1 pratishat), jabki Arwal jaisi kuch jagahon me vriddhi kam rahi (lagbhag 18.9 pratishat). Abadi tez badhne ka asar yah hota hai ki school, aspatal, sadak, peene ka paani tatha rozgaar ki maang lagatar badhti rehti hai; isliye Bihar me parivar-kalyan, maa-shishu swasthya tatha ladkiyon ki padhai par zor diya jaata hai. Isi vriddhi ke kaaran Bihar ki ghanatv bhi badhi, jo 2011 me 1,102 vyakti prati square kilometre ho gayi. 17.64 pratishat bharat ki vriddhi dar hai, isliye woh Bihar ke liye sahi nahi; Kishanganj tatha Patna ke diye gaye aankde bhi sahi nahi. Exam point: Bihar ki 2001-2011 jansankhya vriddhi = 25.42% (bharat 17.64%); sarvadhik vriddhi Madhepura me (karib 31.1%), sarvanimn Arwal me (18.9%).

qe: Which district of Bihar is the only Muslim-majority district as per Census 2011, and what was its Muslim population share?
qh: जनगणना 2011 के अनुसार बिहार का एकमात्र मुस्लिम-बहुल जिला कौन है तथा वहाँ मुस्लिम जनसंख्या का हिस्सा कितना था?
e: Census 2011 ke dharm-vaar aankde batate hain ki Bihar me Hindu jansankhya 82.69 pratishat tatha Muslim jansankhya 16.87 pratishat thi; anya dharmon ka hissa bahut chhota tha. Rajya ka ekmatra Muslim-bahul jila Kishanganj hai, jahan Muslim jansankhya lagbhag 67.98 pratishat thi - yani wahan do tihai se zyada log Muslim hain. Seemanchal kshetra ke anya jile jaise Araria, Purnea tatha Katihar me bhi Muslim jansankhya state average se zyada hai, lekin wahan ye bahumat (50 pratishat se zyada) nahi hai, isliye woh 'Muslim-majority' nahi kehlaate. Kishanganj ki ek khaas baat yah bhi hai ki yahan bharat ki sabse zyada varshik barish Bihar me hoti hai (1,800 millimetre se adhik) tatha chai ki kheti bhi hoti hai, isliye bhugol tatha jansankhya dono ke prashnon me Kishanganj baar-baar aata hai. Isliye sahi uttar 'Kishanganj, 67.98 pratishat' hai. Exam point: Bihar ka ekmatra Muslim-bahul jila = Kishanganj (karib 67.98% Muslim); Bihar me Hindu 82.69% tatha Muslim 16.87% (Census 2011); Seemanchal ke Araria, Purnea, Katihar me Muslim hissa zyada par bahumat nahi.

qe: As per Census 2011, which district had the highest percentage of Scheduled Caste population in Bihar and which had the lowest?
qh: जनगणना 2011 के अनुसार बिहार में अनुसूचित जाति जनसंख्या का सर्वाधिक प्रतिशत किस जिले में तथा न्यूनतम किसमें था?
oe: Highest Gaya (30.39 per cent); lowest Kishanganj (6.69 per cent)
Highest Nawada (28 per cent); lowest Patna (8 per cent)
Highest Aurangabad (26 per cent); lowest Katihar (9 per cent)
Highest Rohtas (25 per cent); lowest Purnea (10 per cent)
oh: सर्वाधिक गया (30.39 प्रतिशत); न्यूनतम किशनगंज (6.69 प्रतिशत)
सर्वाधिक नवादा (28 प्रतिशत); न्यूनतम पटना (8 प्रतिशत)
सर्वाधिक औरंगाबाद (26 प्रतिशत); न्यूनतम कटिहार (9 प्रतिशत)
सर्वाधिक रोहतास (25 प्रतिशत); न्यूनतम पूर्णिया (10 प्रतिशत)
e: Census 2011 me Bihar ki anusuchit jati (SC) jansankhya rajya ki kul jansankhya ka lagbhag 15.91 pratishat thi, yaani karib 1.66 crore log; bharat me SC ka hissa 16.63 pratishat tha, isliye Bihar ka hissa rashtriya ausat se thoda kam tha. Rajya me SC ka sabse zyada pratishat Gaya jile me tha (30.39 pratishat), jo state average ka lagbhag dugna hai; Nawada tatha Aurangabad jaise jile bhi isi patti me aate hain. Sabse kam SC pratishat Kishanganj me tha (6.69 pratishat), jahan Muslim tatha anya samudayon ka hissa zyada hai. SC vargon ke liye samvidhan me aarakshan tatha rajya sarkar ki chhatravritti, chhatravas, kaushal-vikas tatha ajivika yojnayein chalti hain, jisse shiksha tatha aay ke avsar badhein. Baaki diye gaye jile-aankde sahi nahi hain, isliye sahi jodi 'Gaya-Kishanganj' hai. Exam point: Bihar me SC jansankhya = 15.91% (Census 2011); sarvadhik SC pratishat Gaya (30.39%), sarvanimn Kishanganj (6.69%); bharat me SC 16.63%.

qe: Which community lives mainly in West Champaran, the district with the highest Scheduled Tribe percentage in Bihar as per Census 2011?
qh: जनगणना 2011 में बिहार में अनुसूचित जनजाति का सर्वाधिक प्रतिशत वाले जिले पश्चिम चंपारण में मुख्यतः कौन-सा समुदाय निवास करता है?
e: Census 2011 me Bihar ki anusuchit janjati (ST) jansankhya rajya ki kul jansankhya ka lagbhag 1.3 pratishat hi thi - yah bharat ke 8.63 pratishat se bahut kam hai. Rajya me ST ka sabse zyada pratishat West Champaran jile me tha (lagbhag 6.35 pratishat), tatha Katihar tatha Jamui bhi unchi hisse wale jile hain. West Champaran ke Terai kshetra ki mukhya janjati 'Tharu' hai; Tharu log jungle-kheti, machhli-pakad tatha krishi se juda jeevan jeete hain tatha unki apni bhasha tatha lok-sanskriti hai. Santhal, Oraon tatha Munda zyada tar Jharkhand tatha bharat ke anya hisson me baste hain; Bihar me Santhal Bhagalpur-Katihar kshetra me bhi milte hain, lekin 'highest ST percentage wala jila' West Champaran hai tatha wahan ki pramukh janjati Tharu hai. Isliye is prashn ka sahi uttar 'Tharu' hai. Exam point: Bihar me ST jansankhya = 1.3%; sarvadhik ST pratishat West Champaran (6.35%), mukhya janjati Tharu; Katihar tatha Jamui ke ST hisse isse kam hain, isliye woh is prashn ke liye vikalp me hain.

qe: What share of Bihar's population was urban as per Census 2011, and which district was the most urbanised?
qh: जनगणना 2011 के अनुसार बिहार की कितनी प्रतिशत जनसंख्या शहरी थी तथा सर्वाधिक शहरीकृत जिला कौन था?
e: Census 2011 me Bihar ki sirf 11.29 pratishat jansankhya shehron me rehti thi, jabki 88.71 pratishat log gaon me rehte the; bharat me shehri jansankhya 31.16 pratishat thi, isliye Bihar desh ke sabse kam shehrikrit rajyon me se ek hai. Rajya me sabse zyada shehrikaran Patna jile ka tha (lagbhag 43.1 pratishat), kyunki patna rajdhani hone ke kaaran wahan karyalay, degree college, hospital, vyapar tatha rozgaar ke avsar ikatthe hain; Munger tatha Bhagalpur bhi comparatively shehri jile hain. Sabse kam shehrikaran Samastipur jaise jilon me dekha gaya (lagbhag 3.47 pratishat), jahan jansankhya mukhya roop se kheti par nirbhar hai. Ghar-kam shehri rajya hone ka arth yah hai ki vikas yojnaon me gaon ki sadak, peene ka paani, swachhata, aavasiya tatha bijli par khaas zor dena padta hai. Isliye prashn ka sahi jawab '11.29 pratishat, Patna' hai. Exam point: Census 2011 me Bihar me shehri jansankhya = 11.29% (gramin 88.71%); sarvadhik shehrikaran Patna (43.1%), sarvanimn Samastipur (3.47%); bharat me shehri 31.16%.

qe: Which university, established in 1917, is the oldest university of Bihar?
qh: 1917 में स्थापित बिहार का सबसे पुराना विश्वविद्यालय कौन-सा है?
oh: बाबा साहेब भीमराव अंबेडकर बिहार विश्वविद्यालय
e: Patna University ki sthapna 1917 me hui tatha yah Bihar ka sabse purana vishwavidyalaya hai; yah bharat ke sabse purane vishwavidyalayaon me bhi gina jaata hai (Calcutta, Bombay, Madras tatha Allahabad ke baad ki pankti me). Us samay Patna Bihar tatha Orissa prant ki rajdhani thi tatha uchch shiksha ke sabhi kendra ek hi vishwavidyalaya ke adheen the, isliye ise 'unitary' (ek hi Parisar me padhai) vishwavidyalaya ke roop me vikasit kiya gaya. Iske antargat Patna College, Patna Science College tatha anya mahatvapurn college aate hain tatha 1916 me bane Patna High Court ke saath-saath yah shahar vidhik tatha shiksha dono ka kendra ban gaya. Nalanda Vishwavidyalaya ek prachin sansthan tha, tatha Nalanda ke prachin mahavihara ka itihas bahut purana hai, lekin aaj ka 'Nalanda University' 21vein sadi me punah sthapit hua; Magadh tatha Babasaheb Ambedkar Bihar University baad ke dashakon me bane. Isliye sahi uttar 'Patna University' hai. Exam point: Bihar ka sabse purana vishwavidyalaya = Patna University (1917); prachin Nalanda Mahavihara (Kumargupta I, 5vein sadi) tatha aaj ka Nalanda University (2014) alag hain.

qe: The revived Nalanda University, an international university at Rajgir, began its first academic session in which year?
qh: राजगीर में स्थित अंतर्राष्ट्रीय विश्वविद्यालय, पुनर्जीवित नालंदा विश्वविद्यालय का पहला शैक्षणिक सत्र किस वर्ष शुरू हुआ?
e: Prachin Nalanda Mahavihara duniya ka pehla bada avasiya antarrashtriya vishwavidyalaya maana jaata hai, jise 1193 ee. ke aas-paas Bakhtiyar Khalji ne ujjar diya tha. Aadhunik samay me 2010 me sansad ne Nalanda University Act pass kiya tatha 2014 me Rajgir (Nalanda jila) me iska pahila shaikshanik satra shuru hua, isliye yah punarjeevit vishwavidyalaya 21vein sadi ki mahatvapurn pahal hai. Yah vishwavidyalaya mukhya roop se antarrashtriya chhatraon tatha paddhatiyon (jaise Buddhist studies, environment, historical studies) par zor deta hai tatha kai deshon ne iske nirmaan me sahayog diya, jisme China, Japan, Singapore tatha anya desh shaamil hain. Iska campus Rajgir ke paas vikasit kiya gaya hai, taaki prachin mahavihara tatha Buddhist kshetra ka mahatva bahaal rahe. 1917 Patna University ka varsh hai, 2008 me IIT Patna shuru hua tatha 2020 is vishwavidyalaya ke liye koi sthapna-varsh nahi hai, isliye sahi uttar 2014 hai. Exam point: Nalanda University (aadhunik, punarjeevit) = Nalanda University Act 2010, pahla satra 2014 me Rajgir (Nalanda) me; prachin Nalanda Mahavihara UNESCO site tatha Kumargupta I se juda.

qe: Which prestigious engineering institute of Patna was originally established in 1886 as the Bihar School of Engineering?
qh: पटना का कौन-सा प्रतिष्ठित अभियांत्रिकी संस्थान मूल रूप से 1886 में बिहार स्कूल ऑफ इंजीनियरिंग के रूप में स्थापित किया गया था?
e: NIT Patna ka purana naam tatha itihas bahut mahatvapurn hai - 1886 me yah 'Bihar School of Engineering' ke roop me shuru hua tatha aage chal kar 'Bihar College of Engineering' tatha phir 'National Institute of Technology (NIT) Patna' ke roop me vikasit hua. NIT bharat ke una chune hue sansthanon me aate hain jahan engineering ki uchch shiksha tatha anusandhan hota hai tatha unme JEE Main ke aadhaar par chhatra chune jaate hain; NIT Patna ka campus Patna me Ganga kinare ke paas hai. IIT Patna 2008 me Bihar me IIT sthapit hone ke baad shuru hua tatha BIT Patna ek niji sansthan hai; Patna Science College 1917 me bane Patna University ka hissa hai. Isliye 1886 me Bihar School of Engineering ke naam se shuru hone wala sansthan NIT Patna hi hai. Exam point: NIT Patna = 1886 me 'Bihar School of Engineering' ke roop me sthapit; IIT Patna 2008 me shuru; Patna Science College Patna University (1917) se juda.

qe: AIIMS Patna, a premier medical institute of Bihar set up under the Pradhan Mantri Swasthya Suraksha Yojana, became operational in which year?
qh: प्रधानमंत्री स्वास्थ्य सुरक्षा योजना के तहत स्थापित बिहार का प्रमुख चिकित्सा संस्थान एम्स पटना किस वर्ष कार्यरत हुआ?
e: AIIMS Patna (All India Institute of Medical Sciences, Patna) kendriya sarkar ki 'Pradhan Mantri Swasthya Suraksha Yojana' (PMSSY) ke tehat banaya gaya tatha iska kaam 2012 ke aas-paas shuru hua; yah Bihar ke sabse bade sarkari chikitsa tatha medical-shiksha sansthanon me gina jaata hai. AIIMS ka mukhya uddeshya yah hai ki desh ke alag-alag kshetraon me sabse uncha star ka aspatal tatha medical college ho, taaki log ek jagah par ikatthe na hon tatha ilaaj apne hi kshetra me mil sake; yahan MBBS, nursing tatha anya courses bhi padhaaye jaate hain. AIIMS Patna me super-speciality (dil, cancer, neuro tatha anya) ke vibhag sthit hain tatha aadhunik jaanch-upchar ki suvidha hai. Isi tarah ke anya sansthan jaise IIT Patna 2008 me tatha Nalanda University 2014 me shuru hue, jabki AIIMS ka karyarambh 2012 ke aas-paas hua, isliye 2012 sahi uttar hai. Exam point: AIIMS Patna = PMSSY ke tehat 2012 me karyarambh; yah Bihar ka pramukh kendra-sarkar chikitsa tatha medical-shiksha sansthan hai; IIT Patna 2008 tatha Nalanda University pahla satra 2014.

qe: Which is the oldest medical college of Bihar, established in 1925 as the Prince of Wales Medical College?
qh: 1925 में प्रिंस ऑफ वेल्स मेडिकल कॉलेज के रूप में स्थापित बिहार का सबसे पुराना मेडिकल कॉलेज कौन-सा है?
e: Patna Medical College and Hospital (PMCH) Bihar ka sabse purana medical college hai; ise 1925 me 'Prince of Wales Medical College' ke naam se shuru kiya gaya tha tatha azaadi ke baad iska naam badal kar PMCH kar diya gaya. Us samay yah poore Bihar tatha Orissa prant ke chhatraon ke liye medical shiksha ka ekmatra bada kendra tha, isliye yahan se padhe hue doctor poore desh me seva karne lage. Aaj bhi PMCH Bihar ke sabse bade sarkari aspatalon me hai, jahan hazaron marij roz ilaaj ke liye aate hain; isi campus me nursing tatha anya courses bhi chalte hain tatha ise 'upgradation' yojna ke tehat aur vikasit kiya ja raha hai. Nalanda Medical College, Darbhanga Medical College tatha Anugrah Narayan Magadh Medical College (Gaya) baad ke dashakon me bane, isliye 'PMCH' hi sahi uttar hai. Exam point: PMCH = Bihar ka sabse purana medical college, 1925 me 'Prince of Wales Medical College' ke naam se sthapit; yah Bihar ka ek pramukh sarkari aspatal tatha chikitsa-shiksha kendra hai.

qe: Aryabhatta Knowledge University, set up to affiliate technical and medical institutions, is headquartered at which place?
qh: तकनीकी तथा चिकित्सा संस्थानों को संबद्ध करने के लिए स्थापित आर्यभट्ट ज्ञान विश्वविद्यालय का मुख्यालय कहाँ है?
e: Aryabhatta Knowledge University (AKU) 2010 me sthapit hui tatha iska mukhyalay Patna me hai; yah rajya ke engineering, pharmacy, nursing, medical tatha anya professional yah un sansthanon ko sanbaddh (affiliate) karti hai tatha unke pathyakram tatha parikshaon ki nigrani karti hai. Iska naam mahan ganitagya tatha khagol-vigyan ke vidwan Aryabhata ke naam par rakha gaya hai, jinke baare me kaha jaata hai ki unhone Kusumapura (aaj ka Patna) me rah kar 'Aryabhatiya' (499 ee.) likhi. Is vishwavidyalaya ke kaam me technical tatha medical education ke manak (standard) banaye rakhna tatha chhatra-sankhya badhane ke saath gunvatta banaaye rakhna shaamil hai. Gaya me Central University of South Bihar tatha Magadh University, Muzaffarpur me Babasaheb Bhimrao Ambedkar Bihar University tatha Bhagalpur me Tilka Manjhi Bhagalpur University sthit hai, isliye AKU ke liye 'Patna' hi sahi uttar hai. Exam point: Aryabhatta Knowledge University = mukhyalay Patna, 2010 me sthapit, technical tatha medical sansthanon ki affiliating university; Aryabhata ne Kusumapura (Patna) me Aryabhatiya likhi.

qe: Mukhyamantri Balak-Balika Cycle Yojana of Bihar was launched mainly to:
qh: बिहार की मुख्यमंत्री बालक-बालिका साइकिल योजना मुख्यतः किस उद्देश्य से शुरू की गई?
oe: Encourage students, especially girls, to continue secondary education by providing bicycles
Provide free cooking gas connections to poor families
Give free smartphones to students for online classes
Provide free cycles to health workers for field visits
oh: माध्यमिक शिक्षा जारी रखने के लिए छात्रों, विशेषकर छात्राओं को साइकिल देकर प्रोत्साहित करना
गरीब परिवारों को मुफ्त रसोई गैस कनेक्शन
ऑनलाइन कक्षाओं के लिए छात्रों को मुफ्त स्मार्टफोन
स्वास्थ्य कर्मियों को क्षेत्र-भ्रमण हेतु मुफ्त साइकिल
e: Bihar me pehle ladkiyon ka school chhod dena ek badi samasya thi, kyunki gaon se madhyamik (secondary) school door hone par aane-jaane ka kharch tatha suraksha ki chinta maa-baap ko rok deti thi. Isi samasya ko dekhkar Bihar sarkar ne Mukhyamantri Balak-Balika Cycle Yojana shuru ki, jisme kaksha 9 me padhne wale chhatraon (vishesh roop se chhatraon tatha chhaatraon) ko cycle di jaati hai, taaki woh door wale school tak aasani se pahunch sakein. Is yojana ka asar yah hua ki 9ve-10ve me ladkiyon ka enrollment tatha thehraav (retention) badha; iske saath 'Mukhyamantri Kanya Utthan Yojana' jaisi yojnayein bhi chalti hain, jisme intermediate tatha graduation karne wali chhatraon ko protsahan rashi milti hai. Free gas connection (Ujjwala), smartphone yojna tatha health-worker cycle jaisi yojnayein alag uddeshyon ke liye hain, isliye sahi uttar cycle-tatha-shiksha wala hai. Exam point: Mukhyamantri Balak-Balika Cycle Yojana = madhyamik shiksha me thehraav tatha ladkiyon ki padhai badhane ke liye cycle; isi tarah Kanya Utthan Yojana ladkiyon ki uchch shiksha ko protsahit karta hai.

qe: Which central university of Bihar has its main campus at Gaya?
qh: बिहार का कौन-सा केंद्रीय विश्वविद्यालय अपने मुख्य परिसर के साथ गया में स्थित है?
e: Bihar ka kendriya vishwavidyalaya 'Central University of South Bihar' (CUSB) hai tatha iska mukhya parisar Gaya jile me sthit hai; yah kendriya vishwavidyalaya adhiniyam ke tehat banaya gaya tatha kuch samay tak iska naam 'Central University of Bihar' ke roop me bhi istemal hua. Kendriya vishwavidyalaya kendra sarkar dwara paise tatha sanchalit hote hain tatha unme rashtriya mahatva ke pathyakram chalte hain; CUSB me vigyan, samaj-vigyan, bhasha tatha anya vishyon me padhai tatha anusandhan hota hai. Gaya kshetra me Magadh University bhi hai tatha Bodh Gaya ke paas prachin gyan-parampara ka mahatva hai, isliye yahan vishwavidyalaya ka hona aitihasik drishti se mahatvapurn hai. Nalanda University Rajgir (Nalanda) me hai tatha Mahatma Gandhi Central University Bihar me nahi (MG Central University Bihar ke Motihari me hai, lekin yah prashn CUSB ke Gaya parisar ka hai) - isliye sahi uttar Central University of South Bihar hai. Exam point: Bihar ka kendriya vishwavidyalaya = Central University of South Bihar, mukhya parisar Gaya; Nalanda University Rajgir (Nalanda) me; Bihar me ek anya kendriya vishwavidyalaya Mahatma Gandhi Central University (Motihari) bhi hai.

qe: Which is described as the oldest established among the social institutions of the Patna district, with its club house on the bank of the Ganges at Bankipore?
qh: पटना जिले की सामाजिक संस्थाओं में सबसे पुरानी कौन मानी जाती है, जिसका क्लब भवन बांकीपुर में गंगा के किनारे है?
e: Patna jile ki sabse purani sthapit samajik sanstha Bankipore Club mani jaati hai, jiska vistar pichhle saalon me kaafi badha tha. Iska club ghar Bankipore me Ganga ke kinare, Collectorate ke daftaron ke purab me sthit tha. Isi shahar me New Patna Club ki sthapna Mr. Justice F. R. Roe ke prayas se hui, unhone is kaam me Sir Ali Imam, Mr. Justice P. R. Das tatha Mr. Saiyid Sultan Ahmed ka sahyog liya tha; is club me yuropiy tatha bharatiy mila kar assi sadasya the. South Bihar Gymkhana Club ki shuruaat bhi Mr. Justice Roe se judi maani jaati hai, jahan golf links tatha polo ground tha. Aise sansthan dikhate hain ki us daur me shahar ke padhe-likhe tatha sampann logon ka samajik jeevan naye-naye clubon tatha sabhaon ke aas-paas banna shuru ho gaya tha. Exam point: Bankipore Club sabse purani sthapit samajik sanstha thi tatha uska club ghar Bankipore me Ganga ke kinare, Collectorate ke purab me tha; New Patna Club ki sthapna Mr. Justice F. R. Roe ke prayas se hui, jisme Sir Ali Imam tatha Mr. Justice P. R. Das ne sahyog kiya; is club me yuropiy tatha bharatiy mila kar assi sadasya the.

qe: The New Patna Club owed its origin to which Judge, assisted by Sir Ali Imam, Mr. Justice P. R. Das and Mr. Saiyid Sultan Ahmed?
qh: न्यू पटना क्लब की स्थापना किस जज के प्रयास से हुई, जिन्हें सर अली इमाम, मिस्टर जस्टिस पी. आर. दास तथा मिस्टर सैयद सुल्तान अहमद का सहयोग मिला?
e: Nayi rajdhani ban jane ke baad Patna me samajik jeevan tez gati se badla. Isi daur me new capital me New Patna Club ki sthapna hui, jiski shuruaat Mr. Justice F. R. Roe se judi maani jaati hai; unhone is kaam me Sir Ali Imam, Mr. Justice P. R. Das tatha Mr. Saiyid Sultan Ahmed ka sahyog liya. Is club ka bhawan achha tha tatha isme assi sadasya the, jinme yuropiy tatha bharatiy dono shamil the. South Bihar Gymkhana Club ki shuruaat bhi usi jaj se jodi jaati hai, jahan golf links tatha polo ground bana, chahe ve jitna nirman chahte the utna nahi ho paaya. Aise club tatha khel-maidan dikhate hain ki nayi rajdhani me angreji tarz ka samajik jeevan tatha khel-kood ka rivaaj tezi se phaila. Exam point: New Patna Club ki shuruaat Mr. Justice F. R. Roe se judi hai, jinhone Sir Ali Imam, Mr. Justice P. R. Das tatha Mr. Saiyid Sultan Ahmed ke saath milkar ise banaya; club me assi sadasya the tatha yuropiy aur bharatiy dono shamil the; South Bihar Gymkhana Club bhi unhi ke prayas se shuru hui, jahan golf links tatha polo ground tha.

qe: Which association, with its headquarters at Patna, represented the interests of the landlords of the whole of Bihar?
qh: किस संस्था का मुख्यालय पटना में था तथा वह पूरे बिहार के ज़मींदारों के हितों का प्रतिनिधित्व करती थी?
e: Nayi rajdhani ban jane ke baad Patna me kai samajik tatha rajnitik sansthaayein bani. Inme Bihar Landholders' Association ka naam mahatvapurn tha, jiska mukhyalay Patna me tha tatha jo poore Bihar ke zamindaron ke hiton ka pratinidhitva karti thi. Isi shahar me Indian National Congress ki ek shakha tatha Kayasth Sabha ki shakha bhi thi, jo Kayasth samuday ke hiton ko aage badhane ke liye banayi gayi thi. Bihar Hitaishi Library Patna city me ek vachanalay yaani reading-room thi, jisse shahar ke padhe-likhe tatha sampann log jude hue the; tatha Victoria Jubilee Club ek sampoorna samajik sanstha thi, jo Bankipore tatha Patna ke paschim hisse ke bharatiy samaj dwara chalai jaati thi. Aise sansthan dikhate hain ki Patna ab ek aise kendra ke roop me ubhar raha tha jahan rajnitik tatha samajik andolanon ka sangathan hota tha. Exam point: Bihar Landholders' Association ka mukhyalay Patna me tha tatha yah poore Bihar ke zamindaron ke hiton ka pratinidhitva karti thi; Patna me Indian National Congress ki shakha tatha Kayasth Sabha ki shakha bhi thi; Bihar Hitaishi Library Patna city ka ek padhne-kaksh tha tatha Victoria Jubilee Club ek samajik sanstha thi.

qe: Which Muhammadan association of Patna dealt mainly with social questions and kept a watchful eye on the progress of events bearing on the interests of Muhammadans, and of the Sunni sect in particular?
qh: पटना की कौन-सी मुस्लिम संस्था मुख्यतः सामाजिक प्रश्नों पर काम करती थी तथा मुसलमानों, विशेष रूप से सुन्नी वर्ग, के हितों से जुड़ी घटनाओं पर नज़र रखती थी?
e: Patna me kai samudayon tatha vichardhaaraon ki apni sansthaayein ban gayi thin, isliye shahar ka samajik jeevan bahut vividh ho gaya. Muhammadan samuday ki ek sanstha Anjuman Islamia thi, jo mukhya roop se samajik sawalon par kaam karti thi tatha Mussalmanon, khaas taur par Sunni varg, ke hiton se jude aayojanon par nazar rakhti thi. Inke alava Bihar Young Men's Institute, Theosophical Society tatha Gorakshini Sabha jaisi sansthaayein bhi thin. Gorakshini Sabha pashuon yaani gai-bail ki suraksha ke liye banayi gayi thi tatha ise Marwari tatha vyapari varg ke log zyada chandaa dete the, jo apne dharmik vishwas me adhik utsah dikhate the. Is tarah ek hi shahar me dharm, jati tatha vyapar ke aadhaar par bani alag-alag sansthaayein saath-saath kaam kar rahi thin. Exam point: Anjuman Islamia Patna ki Muhammadan sanstha thi jo samajik prashnon par kaam karti thi tatha Mussalmanon, khaas taur par Sunni varg, ke hiton se jude vishayon par nazar rakhti thi; Patna me Bihar Young Men's Institute, Theosophical Society tatha Gorakshini Sabha jaisi sansthaayein bhi thin; Gorakshini Sabha pashuon ki suraksha ke liye thi tatha usse Marwari tatha vyapari varg zyada jude the.

qe: The Bihari newspaper developed from a paper founded in 1894. What was that earlier paper called, and when did the Bihari begin to be published daily?
qh: बिहारी अखबार 1894 में शुरू हुए एक अखबार से विकसित हुआ था। वह पुराना अखबार क्या कहलाता था तथा बिहारी दैनिक रूप में कब छपने लगा?
oe: The Bihar Times, published daily from April 1912
oh: बिहार टाइम्स, जो अप्रैल 1912 से दैनिक छपने लगा
e: Naye prant ban jane ke baad Patna me theek-thak rashtriy samachar-patra nikaalne ki kai koshishen hui; kuch samachar-patra kuch samay tak achhe chale, lekin aage chalkar band ho gaye. Inme sabse ullekhniy 'Bihari' tha, jo 1894 me shuru hue 'Bihar Times' se vikasit hua tatha April 1912 se dainik roop me chhapne laga. Germany ke saath yuddh ke shuru hone par, jab samachar ki maang bahut badhi, use kaafi faayda hua; lekin 1917 me yah band ho gaya. Isi daur ka ek aur achha samachar-patra 'The Express' tha, jise Hathwa ke Maharaja ki aarthik madad prapt thi; yuddh ke samay yah do baar roz chhapta tha, baad me shaam ka akhbaar ban gaya tatha May 1922 me band ho gaya, lekin agli sardiyon me phir shuru kar diya gaya. Inke alava Patna se Bihar Herald tatha Searchlight angreji me tatha Siksha hindi me chap rahe the. Exam point: Bihari akhbaar 1894 me shuru hue Bihar Times se bana tatha April 1912 se dainik chhapne laga; Germany ke saath yuddh ke dauran use faayda hua, lekin 1917 me band ho gaya; The Express Hathwa ke Maharaja ki madad se chalta tha, May 1922 me band hone ke baad agli sardiyon me phir shuru hua; Patna se Bihar Herald tatha Searchlight angreji me tatha Siksha hindi me nikalte the.

qe: Which newspaper of Patna was financed by the Maharaja of Hathwa and appeared twice daily during the war?
qh: पटना का कौन-सा अखबार हथुआ के महाराजा की आर्थिक सहायता से चलता था तथा युद्ध के समय दिन में दो बार छपता था?
e: Patna se nikalne wale akhbaaron me 'The Express' apne tareeke se alag tha. Is akhbaar ki aarthik vyavastha Hathwa ke Maharaja ke sahyog se chalti thi tatha ise achhe tareeke se chalaya jaata tha. Yuddh ke dauran yah din me do baar chhapta tha, lekin baad me yah shaam ka akhbaar ban gaya. May 1922 me iska prakshan band ho gaya, lekin agli sardiyon me ise phir se shuru kar diya gaya; iske alava Patna se abhi Bihar Herald tatha Searchlight angreji me tatha Siksha hindi me nikal rahe the. Isi shahar ka 'Bihari' akhbaar 1894 me shuru hue Bihar Times se bana tha, jo April 1912 se dainik hua tatha 1917 me band ho gaya. Aise varnan dikhate hain ki nayi rajdhani me samachar-patraon ka bazaar abhi bana hua tha - kuch chalte the, kuch band hote the tatha sarkari tatha niji sahyog ka unpar bada asar tha. Exam point: The Express akhbaar Hathwa ke Maharaja ki aarthik madad se chalta tha; yuddh ke samay yah din me do baar chhapta tha tatha baad me shaam ka akhbaar ban gaya; May 1922 me band hone ke baad agli sardiyon me phir shuru hua; Patna se Bihar Herald, Searchlight tatha Siksha bhi nikalte the.

qe: At the 1921 census, what proportion of the population of the Patna district was living in urban areas?
qh: 1921 की जनगणना में पटना जिले की कुल जनसंख्या का कितना हिस्सा शहरी क्षेत्रों में रह रहा था?
e: Patna jile ki jansankhya ke adhyayan me yah baat saaf dikhti hai ki yahan shahari yaani urban abaadi ka hissa sadharan zilon se kaafi zyada tha. 1921 ki ganana ke samay jile me kul 2,18,895 log shahari kshetron me rahte the, jo jile ki kul abaadi ka lagbhag chaudah pratishat tha. Iski mukhya wajah yah thi ki jile me Patna shahar shamil tha, jisse shahri abaadi ka pratishat turant badh gaya. Shahri kshetron me chhah kasbe ganine me liye gaye - Patna, Bihar, Barh, Dinapore, Khagaul tatha Mokameh; lekin Mokameh ke log zyadatar kheti ka kaam karte the tatha kasbe me isliye rahte the ki wahan ka khareef kshetra barish ke mausam me paani me dub jaata tha. Is tarah ek jile ke andar shahari tatha gramin jeevan ek saath dikhta hai. Exam point: 1921 ki ganana me Patna jile ki lagbhag chaudah pratishat abaadi shahri thi (2,18,895 log); iska mukhya karan jile me Patna shahar ka hona tha; shahri ganine me chhah kasbe the - Patna, Bihar, Barh, Dinapore, Khagaul tatha Mokameh.

qe: Which of the six towns of the Patna district had mostly agriculturists living in it because the cultivated land around was submerged in the rainy season?
qh: पटना जिले के छह कस्बों में से किसमें रहने वाले लोग अधिकतर किसान थे, क्योंकि आसपास की खेती योग्य भूमि बरसात में पानी में डूब जाती थी?
e: Patna jile ke shahri kshetron me chhah kasbe ganine me liye gaye the - Patna, Bihar, Barh, Dinapore, Khagaul tatha Mokameh. Inme Mokameh ek aisi jagah thi jahan rehne wale log zyadatar kheti ka kaam karte the, yaani woh kasbe ke rahne wale the magar kisan the. Iska saaf karan yah tha ki us ilake ki kheti ki zameen barish ke mausam me paani me doob jaati thi, isliye log mausam ke hisaab se kasbe me basa kar rahte the tatha kheti ka kaam chalate the. Baaki kasbon me Patna tatha Dinapore jaise sthal vyapar, prashasan tatha fauji chhawni ke liye jaane jaate the, isliye unki abaadi ka svarup alag tha. Aisi jaankari dikhati hai ki shahri-tatha-gramin ka bantwara keval abaadi ka sawal nahi, balki bhu-akar tatha nadi ke vyavhar ka parinaam tha. Exam point: Mokameh ke log zyadatar kisan the tatha kasbe me isliye rahte the kyunki aas-paas ki kheti ki zameen barish me paani me doob jaati thi; shahri ganine me shamil chhah kasbe = Patna, Bihar, Barh, Dinapore, Khagaul tatha Mokameh; Patna tatha Dinapore vyapar, prashasan tatha fauji chhawni ke kendra the.

qe: Which thana of the Patna district had the highest density of population at 1,562 persons to the square mile?
qh: पटना जिले के किस थाने में जनसंख्या का घनत्व सबसे अधिक, प्रति वर्ग मील 1,562 व्यक्ति था?
e: Patna jile me jansankhya ka ghanatv yaani density har jagah ek jaisa nahi thi. Ganga ke kinare base shahri tatha ardha-shahri kshetron me ghanatv sabse zyada tha; Dinapore thana me yah 1,562 vyakti per square mile tatha Phulwari thane me 1,036 vyakti per square mile tak pahunch gaya tha. Jile ka ausat ghanatv lagbhag 740 vyakti per square mile tha, lekin agar jile ke do bade shahron ko alag kar diya jaye, to ghanatv 700 se bhi kam ho jaata tha. Kheti wale thanon me ghanatv sabse kam tha - Mokameh me 506 tatha Masaurhi me 581 vyakti per square mile. Is tarah ghanatv ka naksha dikhata hai ki nadi ke kinare vyapar tatha prashasan ke kendra base the, jabki andar ke ilake kheti par nirbhar the. Exam point: Patna jile me sabse zyada ghanatv Dinapore thane (1,562 vyakti per square mile) tatha uske baad Phulwari (1,036) me tha; jile ka ausat ghanatv lagbhag 740 tha; kheti wale thanon me sabse kam ghanatv Mokameh (506) tatha Masaurhi (581) me tha.

qe: In the Patna district, which agricultural thana had the lowest population density at 506 persons to the square mile?
qh: पटना जिले में किस कृषि-थाने का जनसंख्या घनत्व सबसे कम, प्रति वर्ग मील 506 व्यक्ति था?
e: Patna jile me ghanatv yaani population density kheti tatha vyapar ke area ke hisaab se badalta tha. Ganga ke kinare base shahri kshetron me ghanatv bahut zyada tha, jaise Dinapore thane me 1,562 tatha Phulwari thane me 1,036 vyakti per square mile. Lekin jile ke kheti wale andaruni thanon me ghanatv kam tha; sabse kam ghanatv 506 vyakti per square mile Mokameh thane me tatha usse thoda zyada 581 vyakti per square mile Masaurhi thane me tha. Yah baat vishash hai ki kisi bhi thane ka ghanatv 500 se neeche nahi gaya, yaani poore jile me abaadi ka bantwara bahut had tak barabar tha. Isi kaaran kaha ja sakta hai ki shahri kshetra ghanatv badhaate the, jabki kheti wale kshetra ghanatv ko santulit rakhte the. Exam point: Mokameh thane me ghanatv sabse kam (506 vyakti per square mile) tatha Masaurhi me 581 tha; Dinapore (1,562) tatha Phulwari (1,036) me ghanatv sabse zyada tha; jile me kisi bhi thane ka ghanatv 500 se neeche nahi gaya.

qe: At the revenue survey in Patna each estate was treated as a village, and the number of nominal villages came to how many?
qh: पटना में राजस्व सर्वेक्षण के समय प्रत्येक एस्टेट (भू-संपत्ति) को ही गाँव मान लिया जाता था, जिससे नाम-मात्र के गाँवों की संख्या कितनी हो गई थी?
e: Patna jile me gaon ki ganana ka tareeka apne aap me ek mahatvapurn baat hai. Rajasv sarvekshan ke samay har estate yaani zameen ki har alag jagir ko hi ek gaon yaani mauza maan liya jaata tha; isliye jab estates kaafi bant gaye, to naam-matr ke gaonon ki sankhya bahut badh gayi tatha yah 4,952 tak pahunch gayi. Isse lagta tha ki jile me gaon bahut chhote tatha bahut adhik hain, lekin asliyat me yah keval ganana ka tareeka tha. Isi kaaran aage ek zyada tark-sangat ikai apnaya gaya tatha chhote estates ko unke mukhya gaon me shamil kar diya gaya, jisse gaonon ki sankhya ghat kar 2,596 reh gayi. Aisi jaankari dikhati hai ki sarkari aankdon ka matlab samajhne ke liye unke peeche ki ganana-paddhati ko jaan lena zaruri hota hai. Exam point: rajasv sarvekshan me har estate ko gaon (mauza) maana jaata tha, isliye naam-matr gaonon ki sankhya 4,952 ho gayi; ghanatv keval 500 se upar rehne ke kaaran jile me abaadi ka bantwara santulit tha; chhote estates ko mukhya gaon me shamil karne par gaonon ki sankhya ghat kar 2,596 ho gayi.

qe: The unusually large proportion of urban population in the Patna district was chiefly due to which reason?
qh: पटना जिले में शहरी जनसंख्या का असाधारण रूप से बड़ा हिस्सा मुख्यतः किस कारण था?
oe: Most villages were near the Ganges
The district had large coal fields
The district included the city of Patna
The district had many hill towns
oh: अधिकांश गाँव गंगा के निकट होना
जिले में पटना नगर शामिल होना
जिले में कई पहाड़ी कस्बे होना
e: Patna jile ki abaadi ke varnan me yah baat chaukati hai ki yahan shahri abaadi ka hissa anya zilon se kaafi zyada tha. Iska karan koi vibhinn vyavsayik ya bhu-akar nahi, balki yah tha ki jile ki seema me Patna shahar shamil tha; Patna kshetra ka bada vyaparik, shiksha tatha prashasanik kendra tha, isliye uski abaadi ko shahri ganine me liya gaya. 1921 ki ganana ke samay shahri kshetron ki abaadi 2,18,895 thi, jo jile ki kul abaadi ka lagbhag chaudah pratishat banta tha. Isi jile ke chhah kasbe shahri ganine me the - Patna, Bihar, Barh, Dinapore, Khagaul tatha Mokameh. Is tarah kisi zile ke aankdon ko padhne ke liye yah jaan lena zaruri hai ki uski seema me kaun-kaun se shahar tatha kasbe shamil the. Exam point: Patna jile me shahri abaadi ka hissa zyada hone ka mukhya karan jile me Patna shahar ka shamil hona tha; 1921 me shahri abaadi 2,18,895 (lagbhag chaudah pratishat) thi tatha chhah kasbe shahri ganine me the.

qe: In the Patna district around 1921, which were counted as the six urban areas?
qh: 1921 के आसपास पटना जिले में किन छह स्थानों को शहरी क्षेत्र माना गया था?
oe: Patna, Dinapore, Fatuha, Maner, Phulwari and Masaurhi
Patna, Bihar, Gaya, Barh, Masaurhi and Phulwari
Patna, Dinapore, Khagaul, Sonepur, Barh and Masaurhi
Patna, Bihar, Barh, Dinapore, Khagaul and Mokameh
oh: पटना, दानापुर, फतुहा, मनेर, फुलवारी तथा मसौढ़ी
पटना, बिहार, गया, बाढ़, मसौढ़ी तथा फुलवारी
पटना, दानापुर, खगौल, सोनपुर, बाढ़ तथा मसौढ़ी
पटना, बिहार, बाढ़, दानापुर, खगौल तथा मोकामा
e: Patna jile ki abaadi ke varnan me chhah shahri kshetra ganine me liye gaye the - Patna, Bihar, Barh, Dinapore, Khagaul tatha Mokameh. In sabhi kshetron me abaadi ka ghanatv tatha jeevan ka tareeka gaon se alag tha; Patna tatha Dinapore jaise sthal prashasan, shiksha tatha fauji chhawni ke kendra the, jabki Barh tatha Mokameh nadi ke kinare vyaparik kasbe the. Yah baat vishash thi ki Bihar yaani Bihar Sharif bhi ek alag shahri kshetra maana gaya, jo aage Nalanda jile ka bada kasba bana. In kasbon ko shamil karne se jile ki shahri abaadi 2,18,895 tak pahunch gayi, jo us daur me kaafi bada aankda tha. Aisi jaankari zile ke nagar-network ko samajhne ke liye upyogi hoti hai. Exam point: Patna jile ke chhah shahri kshetra the - Patna, Bihar, Barh, Dinapore, Khagaul tatha Mokameh; inhe ganine me lene se shahri abaadi 2,18,895 ho gayi; Patna tatha Dinapore prashasan, shiksha tatha fauji chhawni ke bade kendra the.

qe: In the Patna district rice was not the staple food of the poor, but rather the food of which class?
qh: पटना जिले में चावल गरीबों का मुख्य भोजन नहीं, बल्कि किस वर्ग का भोजन था?
e: Bangal me chawal mukhya aahar mana jaata tha, lekin Patna jile ki sthiti isse alag thi. Yahan chawal garib logon ka nahi, balki apekshakrut sampann logon ka bhojan tha. Aam garib tatha kisan apne bhojan me aate se bani moti rotiyan khate the, jo gehu ya kai mota anaj tatha dalon ke aate se tawa par sek kar banai jaati thin. Isi ke saath ve tarkari, namak tatha kuch simple masale lete the, tatha kabhi usi anaj ki dalia bana kar bhojan me badlav laate the. Is tarah dekhne me aata hai ki aahar keval ruchi ka vishay nahi tha, balki us kshetra me kya paidawar hoti thi tatha garib ki jeb kitni bharpur hai, uspar nirbhar karta tha. Exam point: Patna jile me chawal garibon ka mukhya aahar nahi, balki sampann logon ka bhojan tha; aam log gehu tatha mote anaj ke aate se bani rotiyan ya bannock khate the tatha usi anaj ki dalia bhi banaate the.

qe: Among the poorest classes of the Patna district the morning meal usually consisted of what?
qh: पटना जिले के सबसे गरीब वर्गों में सुबह का भोजन सामान्यतः किस चीज़ से बना होता था?
oe: Parched or boiled grains of various sorts
oh: घी के साथ गेहूँ की रोटी
सब्जियों के साथ मक्के का आटा
दूध तथा चीनी के साथ चावल
भुने या उबले हुए विभिन्न प्रकार के अनाज
e: Patna jile ke sabse garib logon me din ka pehla bhojan bahut saral hota tha. Unka subah ka bhojan aksar bhune ya uble hue tarah-tarah ke anaj yaani chana, bhuna gehu, makka jaise anaj se banta tha; shaam ka bhojan uble chawal, dal tatha kabhi-kabhi tarkari ki curry se banta tha. Mota anaj isliye istemal hota tha kyunki woh sasta padta tha tatha aas-paas ke khet me paidavar ke roop me aasani se mil jaata tha. Isi tarah kshetra me arhar, jise Cajanus indicus kaha jaata hai, uski dal tatha uske aate ka gada yaani pottage bhi bhojan me shamil hota tha. Aise varnan se us daur ke gaon ke garib parivar ke bhojan ka saaf chitra milta hai. Exam point: sabse garib logon ka subah ka bhojan bhune ya uble anaj se tatha shaam ka bhojan uble chawal, dal tatha kabhi tarkari se banta tha; arhar ki dal tatha uske aate ka gada bhi aahar me shamil tha; saral bhojan saste tatha sthanik paidavar ke kaaran hota tha.

qe: Which of these was eaten by the people of the Patna district whenever it could be procured?
qh: पटना जिले के लोग निम्नलिखित में से किसे जब भी उपलब्ध हो सके खाते थे?
e: Patna jile ke logon ka bhojan mukhya roop se saste tatha aasani se milne wale anajon se banta tha. Inme makka aisa anaj tha jise woh jab bhi mil sake khate the; makka us kshetra me aasani se ugta tha tatha usse moti rotiyan tatha usse banaya gaya aata kaam aata tha. Gehu ya kisi bhi mote anaj ke aate se tawa par sek kar badi rotiyan yaani bannock banai jaati thin, jo tarkari, namak tatha kuch masalon ke saath khai jaati thin; usi anaj ki dalia bana kar bhojan me badlav bhi laaya jaata tha. Isi tarah mandua ya marua, jise ragi bhi kehte hain, Bihar subdivision me zyada khaya jaata tha, aur arhar tatha kai tarah ki dalen tatha mota anaj kisan ke bhojan ka hissa the. Exam point: Patna jile me makka jab bhi mil sake kha liya jaata tha tatha gehu ya mote anaj ke aate se bani moti rotiyan (bannock) mukhya bhojan thi; mandua ya marua (ragi) Bihar subdivision me zyada khaya jaata tha; arhar tatha kai moti dalen bhi bhojan me shamil thin.

qe: Marua (Eleusine coracana), a kind of millet, was consumed largely in which part of the Patna district?
qh: मड़ुआ (एलुसीन कोराकाना), जो एक प्रकार का मोटा अनाज है, पटना जिले के किस भाग में अधिक खाया जाता था?
e: Patna jile me mota anaj tatha dalen kisan ke bhojan ka bada hissa thin. Inme mandua ya marua, jise ragi bhi kaha jaata hai, ek aisa mota anaj tha jo mukhya roop se Bihar subdivision me zyada khaya jaata tha; mandua yaani Eleusine coracana sasta tatha poshak anaj maana jaata tha, isliye birhar tatha majdoor varg uspar adhik nirbhar karte the. Isi jile me Dinapore thana me aabadi ka ghanatv sabse zyada tha, isliye wahan ke logon ka bhojan aas-paas ke shahari bazaaron par nirbhar karta tha. Is tarah ek hi jile ke alag-alag hisson me khaane-peene ki aadatein zameen tatha paidawar ke hisaab se badalti thin. Exam point: mandua ya marua (Eleusine coracana) Patna jile ke Bihar subdivision me zyada khaya jaata tha; yah sasta tatha poshak mota anaj tha, isliye kisan tatha majdoor ispar adhik nirbhar the; jile ke anya hisson me aahar ke andaaz alag the.

qe: Which dialect of Bihari Hindi is current over the whole of the Patna district?
qh: बिहारी हिंदी की कौन-सी बोली पूरे पटना जिले में प्रचलित है?
e: Patna jile me bolchal ki bhasha ya boli Magahi thi, jo Magadhi boli ka hi ek roop hai. Magadha ilake ke naam par basi yah boli jile bhar me chalti thi; yah Patna tatha Gaya jile ke aas-paas ki boli thi, lekin isi ilake tak seemit nahi thi. Hazaribagh zile me bhi yah boli chalti thi, pashchim me Palamau ke kuch hisse tak tatha purab me Monghyr tatha Bhagalpur ke kuch hisson tak yah phaili hui thi; poore is kshetra me yah ek hi boli thi, jisme sthanik antar bahut kam mile. Isi kaaran yah kshetra ki pehchaan ka bada hissa maana jaata hai. Exam point: Patna jile me Bihari Hindi ki Magahi boli prachalit thi; yah Gaya tatha Patna ke Magadha ilake ki boli hai, lekin Hazaribagh, Palamau ke kuch hisse tatha Monghyr-Bhagalpur ke hisson tak bhi phaili hui hai; is kshetra me iske sthanik roop me vishesh antar nahi milte.

qe: The Magahi spoken in the Patna district is not so pure as that of Gaya because it is infected by which two influences?
qh: पटना जिले की मगही गया की मगही जितनी शुद्ध नहीं है, क्योंकि वह किन दो प्रभावों से मिली हुई है?
oe: Maithili from north of the Ganges and Urdu idioms of the city's Muslim population
oh: उत्तर में गंगा के पार की मैथिली तथा शहर की मुस्लिम आबादी की उर्दू
e: Bihari Hindi ki Magahi boli Patna tatha Gaya dono jilon me chalti hai, lekin dono jagah ka roop ek jaisa nahi hai. Patna jile ki boli Gaya ki tulna me kam shuddh mani jaati hai, kyunki uspar do taraf se asar pada - ek taraf Ganga ke uttar ki Maithili boli ka prabhav tatha doosri taraf shahar ki bahusankhyak Mussalman abaadi ki boli, jisse usne kai Urdu ke muhavare tatha shabd le liye. Magahi ki ek aur visheshta yah hai ki usme kriya yaani verb ke roop bahut jatil tareeke se badalte hain, isi kaaran vidvan ise Maithili ke kareeb maante hain; antar yah hai ki Maithili par shatabdiyon tak vidvan Brahmanon ka prabhav raha, jabki Magahi bolne wale log lambe samay tak anpadhe maane jaate rahe. Exam point: Patna ki Magahi Ganga ke uttar ki Maithili tatha shahar ki Mussalman abaadi ki Urdu dono ke sampark se mishrit ho gayi, isliye woh Gaya ki boli se kam shuddh maani jaati hai; Magahi me kriya-roop badalne ki vyavastha jatil hai, isliye ise Maithili ke nazdik mana jaata hai.

qe: Among the people of the Patna district, a porridge or pottage was made from which pulse (Cajanus indicus)?
qh: पटना जिले के लोगों में किस दाल (कजानस इंडिकस) से गाढ़ा दलिया या पोटेज बनाया जाता था?
e: Patna jile ke logon ke bhojan me dalon ka bada sthan tha, tatha inme arhar ka naam alag tha. Arhar ka vaigyanik naam Cajanus indicus hai; ise kabhi aate ke roop me tatha kabhi gade dalie yaani pottage ke roop me khaya jaata tha. Shaam ka bhojan uble chawal ya usi anaj ki dalia, dal ya pulse tatha kabhi-kabhi tarkari ki curry se banta tha; garib parivar ke yahan yeh bhojan halka magar poshak hota tha. Maize, mandua yaani ragi jaise mota anaj tatha kai tarah ki dalen kisan ke samanya bhojan ka hissa thin, isliye mota anaj tatha dalen mil kar us kshetra ke aahar ki pahchaan ban gayin. Exam point: arhar (Cajanus indicus) ko aate ke roop me tatha gade dalie ke roop me khaya jaata tha; Magadh kshetra ke kisan ke bhojan me dalen tatha mota anaj jaise makka tatha mandua mukhya the; shaam ke bhojan me uble chawal, dal tatha kabhi tarkari shamil hoti thi.

qe: Which game, played under the Association Code, did the young men of Patna take to with great enthusiasm?
qh: पटना के युवक किस खेल को एसोसिएशन कोड के अनुसार बड़े उत्साह से खेलने लगे थे?
e: Patna jile ke logon ke kapde, ghar tatha khel-kood aas-paas ke Shahabad jile ke logon se bahut alag nahi the. Lekin ek baat vishisht thi - Patna ke yuva angreji yaani British tarah ke khelon me Shahabad ke shaharon ke yuvaon se bhi zyada utsah dikhate the, tatha football ko Association Code ke tahat khelna unme bahut lokpriya ho gaya tha. Isse pata chalta hai ki us daur me shahar ke yuvaon ke manoranjan me naye khelon ka pravesh ho raha tha tatha woh aapas me mukabla karne ke liye sangathit hote the. Aise varnan samajik jeevan tatha naye shauk ke badalte roop ko samajhne me madad karte hain. Exam point: Patna ke yuvaon me Association Code ke tahat khela jane wala football bahut lokpriya tha tatha isme unka utsah aas-paas ke Shahabad jile ke shaharon se bhi zyada dikhta tha; kapde, ghar tatha anya khel-kood mein zile ka jeevan aas-paas ke zilon jaisa hi tha.

qe: Which village official keeps the account of the village rent collections?
qh: गाँव का कौन-सा अधिकारी गाँव में भू-भाटक (लगान) की वसूली का हिसाब रखता है?
e: Patna jile ke gaon me kai karmchari kaam karte the, jinme patwari sabse mahatvapurn tha. Uska mukhya kaam gaon me lagan yaani rent ki vasooli ka hisab rakhna tha. Ek vishesh baat yah thi ki asli raiyat ke bhes me ek karmchari hote the jo rajya ka naukar hota tha tatha lagan vasool karne wale ke upar nigrani rakhta tha; lekin Permanent Settlement ke baad wohi patwari zamindar ka naukar ban gaya. Iske badle uski haisiyat badal gayi - pehle woh sarkar ka nigranak tha, baad me woh zamindar ke hit ka dekhne wala ban gaya. Jab ek gaon me kai estate ban gaye, to aksar ek gaon me ek se zyada patwari ho jaate the tatha har patwari apni estate ka hisab rakhta tha. Exam point: patwari gaon me lagan vasooli ka hisab rakhta tha; pehle woh rajya ka naukar tatha vasoolkar par nigrani rakhne wala adhikari tha; Permanent Settlement ke baad woh zamindar ka naukar ban gaya tatha estate vibhajan ke kaaran ek gaon me kai patwari bhi ho sakte the.

qe: What change came about in the position of the patwari after the Permanent Settlement?
qh: पटवारी की स्थिति में स्थायी बंदोबस्त के बाद क्या परिवर्तन हुआ?
oe: He became an officer of the district court
He passed from being a servant of the state to a servant of the zamindar
He was replaced by the gumashta everywhere
He was made headman of the village
oh: वह जिला अदालत का अधिकारी बन गया
वह राज्य का कर्मचारी रहता हुआ ज़मींदार का कर्मचारी बन गया
उसे हर जगह गुमाश्ता ने बदल दिया
उसे गाँव का मुखिया बना दिया गया
e: Patna jile me patwari bahut purana gaon-adhikari tha. Us samay yah adhikari rajya ka naukar tha tatha lagan vasoolne wale par nigrani rakhta tha. Iske badle woh ek vishesh kaam karta tha. Iska mukhya uddeshya gaon ke raiyaton se jo lagan vasool hoti thi, uska poora hisab rakhna tha. Permanent Settlement ke baad haalat badal gayin. Ab woh rajya ka naukar nahi, balki zamindar ka naukar ban gaya. Patwaris aksar keval do rupaye mahine ka naami vetan paate the, lekin bade estates me unhe aath ya das rupaye bhi milte the; jahan vetan keval naam ka hota tha, wahan unhe produce-rent yaani anaj ke roop me milne wali vasooli par chhah-solah hisse seer per maund ke hisaab se bhatta milta tha. Exam point: Permanent Settlement se pehle patwari rajya ka naukar tha tatha grihasth ke maalik ki taraf se nahi, upar se kaam karta tha; bad me woh zamindar ka naukar ban gaya; uska vetan do se das rupaye mahina tak hota tha tatha anaj-vasooli par chhah-solah hisse seer per maund bhatta bhi milta tha.

qe: Which village official collects the rents and looks after the interest of his zamindar, often on a nominal pay with a share in abwabs and a commission?
qh: गाँव का कौन-सा अधिकारी लगान वसूल करता है तथा अपने ज़मींदार के हित की देखरेख करता है, जिसे अक्सर नाम-मात्र वेतन तथा अबवाब में हिस्सा एवं कमीशन मिलता है?
e: Gaon me lagan vasoolne tatha zamindar ke hit ki dekh-rekh karne wala adhikari gumashta kehlata tha. Uska vetan aksar naam-matra hota tha, isliye uski aay ka bada hissa abwab yaani lagan ke upar li jaane wali chhoti-chhoti vasooliyon me hisse tatha produce-rent par commission se chalta tha; jahan anaj ke roop me lagan milti thi, wahan uske hisse ka hisaab chhah-solah seer per maund ke hisaab se hota tha. Gumashta ke saath barahil log kaam karte the, jo uski madad se lagan vasoolte the tatha unka commission aksar chhah-solah hisse se kam hota tha. Aisi vyavastha dikhati hai ki us daur me gaon ka revenue-tantra vetan se zyada abwab tatha commission par chalta tha, jisse raiyaton par bhoj badh jaata tha. Exam point: lagan vasoolne wala adhikari gumashta tha tatha woh naam-matra vetan, abwab me hissa tatha anaj-lagan par chhah-solah hisse seer per maund commission paata tha; barahil uski madad karte the, jinka commission chhah-solah hisse se kam hota tha.

qe: Which village official was the watchman of the zamindar's village office, carried messages for the gumashta and escorted raiyats to the zamindar's presence?
qh: गाँव का कौन-सा अधिकारी ज़मींदार के गाँव-कार्यालय का चौकीदार था, गुमाश्ता के संदेश ले जाता था तथा रैयतों को ज़मींदार के सामने ले जाता था?
e: Gaon ke revenue-karmchariyon me gorait ka kaam suraksha tatha sandesh pahunchane se juda tha. Woh zamindar ke gaon-karyalay ka chaukidar tha, gumashta ke sandesh ek jagah se doosri jagah pahunchata tha tatha un raiyaton ko, jo zamindar ki rivaz ki maangon ko poora karne jaate the, izzat ke saath zamindar ke saamne pesh karta tha. Aisi maangon me ghee, doodh, bakri tatha aise hi anya saman shamil hote the, jinke daam rivaz ke hisaab se kam liye jaate the. Gorait kabhi-kabhi jaribkash yaani zameen naapne wale ka kaam bhi karta tha tatha aise jhagde me test yaani jaanch bhi karata tha. Is tarah yah adhikari zamindari vyavastha me aankh-kan ke roop me kaam karta tha. Exam point: gorait zamindar ke gaon-karyalay ka chaukidar tha, gumashta ke sandesh le jata tha tatha raiyaton ko zamindar ke saamne pesh karta tha; ghee, doodh tatha bakri jaisi maangein uske zariye pahunchti thin; woh jaribkash ka kaam bhi karta tha.

qe: The hatwa is a permanent institution in villages where a large proportion of the rent is paid in kind. What was his function?
qh: जिन गाँवों में लगान का बड़ा हिस्सा अनाज के रूप में दिया जाता था, वहाँ हटवा स्थायी संस्था था। उसका कार्य क्या था?
oe: To guard the village granary at night
To weigh the crops for division and make the test in disputed appraisements
To collect the rent in cash
oh: रात में गाँव के कोठार की रखवाली करना
बँटवारे के लिए फसल तोलना तथा विवादित अनुमानों में परीक्षण करना
e: Patna jile ke kai gaon me lagan ka bada hissa anaj yaani kind ke roop me diya jaata tha. Aise gaon me hatwa ek sthayi adhikari hota tha, isliye uski upasthiti zaruri maani jaati thi. Uska mukhya kaam katai ke baad faslon ko tolna tha, jisse zamindar tatha raiyat ke hisse theek-theek bant jayein; isi tarah jab kisi khet ya fasl ke anuman par jhagda hota, to uske test yaani jaanch ka kaam bhi hatwa hi karta tha. Yah kaam mahatvapurn tha, kyunki anaj ke roop me lagan lene se hisse-bantware ka jhagda aam baat thi tatha tolne wale ki neeyat par hi poora faisla nirbhar karta tha. Aise adhikari dikhate hain ki gaon ka revenue-tantra alag-alag kaam ke liye alag-alag karmchari rakhta tha. Exam point: hatwa yaani tulawan gaon me sthayi adhikari tha tatha uske hat me faslon ko tolne tatha jhagde ke samay parikshan karne ka kaam tha; yeh vyavastha un gaon me thi jahan lagan ka bada hissa anaj me diya jaata tha.

qe: Who is the jeth-raiyat or mahatwara of a village?
qh: गाँव का जेठ-रैयत या महतवारा कौन होता था?
oe: The principal cultivator of the village, appointed by the landlord
The oldest man of the village
oh: गाँव का प्रमुख कृषक, जिसे ज़मींदार नियुक्त करता था
e: Gaon ka jeth-raiyat ya mahatwara woh pramukh kisan hota tha, jise zamindar is samajh par niyukt karta tha ki woh apne prabhav se gaon ke raiyaton ko zamindar ke paksh me rakhega. Iske badle me uski kuch suvidhayen hoti thin - gaon ke sinchai ke kaam yaani aahar-pyne ki marammat ke samay woh zamindar se peshgi yaani advance leta tha tatha us kaam ki nigrani khud karta tha; agar gaon me koi gumashta nahi hota, to woh zamindar ki taraf se lagan bhi vasoolta tha, tatha in sewaon ke badle uska lagan thoda kam rakha jaata tha. Is tarah yah ek pul ka kaam karta tha, jo zamindar tatha raiyaton ke beech sampark banaye rakhta tha. Aise prabandh se pata chalta hai ki us daur me zamindari prashasan niji rishton tatha prabhav par tika tha. Exam point: jeth-raiyat ya mahatwara gaon ka pramukh kisan hota tha, jise zamindar niyukt karta tha; woh sinchai ke kaam me peshgi lekar nigrani karta tha, zarurat padne par lagan bhi vasoolta tha tatha badle me thoda kam lagan deta tha.

qe: In the Patna district the amin was specially appointed by the zamindar for which work?
qh: पटना जिले में अमीन को ज़मींदार द्वारा विशेष रूप से किस काम के लिए नियुक्त किया जाता था?
oh: अनाज के रूप में लगान तोलना
e: Patna jile ke gaon me amin ek aisa adhikari tha, jise zamindar vishesh roop se anuman lene tatha uske samay par hue jhagde ke liye niyukt karta tha. Anuman ka matlab tha yah andaza lagana ki kisi khet me kitni fasal hui hai tatha uske hisaab se lagan ka hissa kitna banega. Ek hi amin zaruri nahi tha ki poore gaon ke anumanon me shamil ho; bade estates me amin aksar zamindar ke mukhyalay ke staff ka hissa hota tha, tatha jahan anuman ho raha tha, wahan gaon ka rahne wala nahi hota tha - isse yah bharosa rakhna tha ki woh sthanik prabhav se prabhavit nahi hoga. Gaon ke aise lagbhag sabhi revenue-karmchari, hatwa ko chhod kar, zamindar ke naukar the, gaon ke nahi. Exam point: amin ko zamindar anuman yaani appraisement ke liye niyukt karta tha; bade estates me woh zamindar ke mukhyalay ka staff hota tha tatha anuman wale gaon ka nivasi nahi hota tha; gaon ke adhiktar revenue-karmchari zamindar ke naukar the.

qe: Apart from the revenue officials, whose wife acts as the midwife of the village in the Patna district?
qh: पटना जिले में राजस्व-अधिकारियों के अतिरिक्त गाँव की दाई का काम किसकी पत्नी करती थी?
e: Patna jile ke gaon me revenue ke adhikariyon ke alava aise kai karmchari the jo gaon ki rozana zaruraton ke liye zaruri the. Inme nai yaani hajjam aata tha, jo shadi tatha mrityu jaisi rasmon me mahatvapurn kaam karta tha; badhai tatha lohar kheti ke auzaar banane tatha unki marammat ke liye zaruri the; dhobi kapde dhota tha; tatha chamar ki patni gaon me dai yaani midwife ka kaam karti thi. Is tarah gaon ek aisi chhoti vyavastha thi jisme kai peshe apne-apne kaam se jude the tatha lagbhag sabhi aavashyaktaon ki poori gaon me hi ho jaati thi. Aise varnan se gaon ki aatm-nirbhar arthavyavastha tatha jati-peshe ke rishte ka pata chalta hai. Exam point: gaon me dai ka kaam chamar ki patni karti thi; nai shadi tatha mrityu ki rasmon me mahatvapurn bhumika nibhata tha; badhai tatha lohar kheti ke auzaar banane ke liye tatha dhobi kapde dhone ke liye zaruri the.
